blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books; word forms checked with the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Город Гдыня ___ был маленькой рыбацкой деревушкой.
exercises.why: **когда-то** — a positive statement about the past or present. «In positive statements referring to the past or present use -то.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59.
exercises.prompt: The city of Gdynia was once a small fishing village.

exercises.q: Потом он её бросил и женился на ___ актрисульке.
exercises.why: **какой-то** — a positive statement about the past or present. «In positive statements referring to the past or present use -то.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59.
exercises.prompt: Then he left her and married some random actress.

exercises.q: Вяжись к ___ своей весовой категории, хулиган!
exercises.why: **кому-нибудь** — -нибудь in this imperative sentence. — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59. «In interrogative and imperative sentences use -нибудь.»
exercises.prompt: Pick on somebody your own size, you bully.

exercises.why: **когда-нибудь** — -нибудь in this interrogative sentence. — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59. «In interrogative and imperative sentences use -нибудь.»
exercises.prompt: Have you ever used a slide rule?

exercises.q: У тебя есть ___ плёнка для этого киноаппарата?
exercises.why: **какая-нибудь** — -нибудь in this interrogative sentence. — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59. «In interrogative and imperative sentences use -нибудь.»
exercises.prompt: Do you have any film for this camera?

exercises.q: Мне кажется, что я уже ___ видел этого очкарика.
exercises.why: **где-то** — a positive statement about the past or present. «In positive statements referring to the past or present use -то.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59.
exercises.prompt: It seems to me that I've seen this person wearing glasses somewhere before.

exercises.q: Интересно, когда пещерный человек сказал ___ подобное.
exercises.why: **что-то** — a positive statement about the past or present. «In positive statements referring to the past or present use -то.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59.
exercises.prompt: I wonder when a caveman said something like this.

exercises.q: Есть ___ домашнее средство от сухости в горле?
exercises.why: **какое-нибудь** — -нибудь in this interrogative sentence. — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59. «In interrogative and imperative sentences use -нибудь.»
exercises.prompt: Is there a home remedy for dry throat?

exercises.q: Ты знаешь ___, кто сдал прошлогодний экзамен?
exercises.why: **кого-нибудь** — -нибудь in this interrogative sentence. — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59. «In interrogative and imperative sentences use -нибудь.»
exercises.prompt: Do you know anybody who passed last year's exam?

exercises.q: Это было ___, что я должен был запрограммировать.
exercises.why: **что-то** — a positive statement about the past or present. «In positive statements referring to the past or present use -то.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59.
exercises.prompt: It would be something I'd have to program.

exercises.q: ___ сказал Тому, когда ему надлежит быть здесь?
exercises.why: **кто-нибудь** — -нибудь in this interrogative sentence. — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59. «In interrogative and imperative sentences use -нибудь.»
exercises.prompt: Did anyone tell Tom what time he was supposed to be here?

exercises.q: Ты знаешь ___ блюдо, в котором есть лавровый лист?
exercises.why: **какое-нибудь** — -нибудь in this interrogative sentence. — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59. «In interrogative and imperative sentences use -нибудь.»
exercises.prompt: Do you know of a dish that has laurel leaves in it?

exercises.q: Вымещай свою злость на ___ другом, ладно?
exercises.why: **ком-нибудь** — -нибудь in this interrogative sentence. — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59. «In interrogative and imperative sentences use -нибудь.»
exercises.prompt: Vent your anger on someone else, will you?

exercises.why: **какой-то** — a positive statement about the past or present. «In positive statements referring to the past or present use -то.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59.
exercises.prompt: Tom gave Mary something cold to drink.

exercises.q: Выглядит так, словно ___ заблевал все стены.
exercises.why: **кто-то** — a positive statement about the past or present. «In positive statements referring to the past or present use -то.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59.
exercises.prompt: Looks like someone threw up their guts all over the walls.

exercises.q: В двадцать с ___ лет она работала инструктором по аэробике.
exercises.why: **чем-то** — a positive statement about the past or present. «In positive statements referring to the past or present use -то.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 59.
exercises.prompt: She worked as an aerobics instructor in her twenties.
